## How much does Brave Search API cost?

Brave Search API pricing starts at $4/per 1K queries across 3 plans, with enterprise pricing available on request. Plans include Search (custom pricing), Answers (custom pricing), Enterprise (custom pricing).

[Calculate Your Cost Estimate Brave Search API total cost for your team size→](https://costbench.com/software/ai-search-apis/brave-search-api/calculator/)[Brave Search API vs Perplexity Sonar API Side-by-side pricing comparison→](https://costbench.com/compare/brave-search-api-vs-perplexity-sonar-api/)

Brave Search API has 3 pricing plans ranging from $4 to $5/per 1K queries. The Search plan requires contacting sales for a custom quote and is designed for production rag. The Answers plan requires contacting sales for a custom quote and is designed for ai agents & chatbots. The Enterprise plan requires contacting sales for a custom quote and is designed for large-scale deployments.

This pricing was last verified in May 19, 2026 from 1 independent source.

[Try Brave Search API Free](https://costbench.com/go/brave-search-api?ref=hero_cta&src=brave-search-api)

Brave Search API offers three tiers: a Search plan billed per 1K queries for production RAG workloads, an Answers plan billed per 1K queries for AI agents and chatbots, and an Enterprise plan with custom pricing for large-scale deployments. There is no flat monthly fee on usage-based tiers — costs scale directly with query volume.
